sections.notes: Use dark full-width hero background with white text. Place headline, subheadline, supporting line, and primary CTA in a centered content column. Include a product-relevant visual treatment in hero body using a generative AI media collage or model preview strip, not a form. Keep spacing generous and ensure the page clearly scrolls beyond hero.

Make this a dominant trust signal. Since no badges/customer counts are provided, build as a sticky logo bar with generic partner/logo slots and a short trust statement area. Keep it visually compact but persistent across scroll. Use dark theme-adapted light cards/logos on a slightly lighter charcoal band.

Section for Seedream 4.5. Start with section intro, then 5 feature cards in a 3-column grid and 2-row wrap. Use clean white cards on dark-page section contrast via tinted panel background. Include one primary CTA button for Request Demo at section end.

Create a dedicated video gallery section because requested in context. Use a large featured video preview tile plus a 4-item thumbnail grid beneath or beside it. All items should feel relevant to AI video generation: motion, lip-sync, cinematic camera, audio-visual sync. No invented testimonials or pricing. Ensure gallery is media-led and clearly distinct from product feature cards.

Section for Seedance 1.5 Pro. Present intro copy followed by 6 feature cards in a 3-column grid. Preserve a strong hierarchy: model description first, then capabilities. Because no CTA is provided, omit CTA here rather than inventing one.

heroStrategy.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
heroStrategy.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro—advanced foundation models for professional visual content creation.
heroStrategy.designNote: Use a full-bleed dark hero with a premium orange-tinted mesh gradient, subtle grid lines, and a layered operational-dashboard composition. Place the headline and CTA in a left-aligned content column over the background, while the right side is a floating media rail of 3–4 cinematic preview tiles showing image generation, motion, and audio-video sync. Add a logo-first trust marquee directly beneath the hero copy. Keep the overall feel enterprise-assured and technically advanced, with strong contrast, glass surfaces, and orange accent CTA only.

repetitionBreakers: Use a full-bleed dark hero with a layered product composite, then switch immediately to a logo-first trust band.
Make the product area alternating and module-based so image and video sections feel distinct.
Use a spotlight-plus-grid for the 5+ Seedream features, then a split-panel or accordion-with-visual for Seedance to change cadence.
Shift from proof-heavy storytelling into a tighter pricing-and-CTA finish.
blueprint.pageTitle: Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro by ByteDance | AI Image and Video Generation
blueprint.metaDescription: Create high-quality AI images and videos with ByteDance’s Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro. Explore how it works, trusted logos, key features, pricing, and get started.

sections.backgroundTreatment: dark radial glow with data-grid overlay and floating preview panels
sections.designNote: Hero is content-first and answers what this is, who it is for, and what to do next. Keep the headline direct and enterprise-assured, with a short subheadline and a single solid orange Get started button. Use compact proof bullets beside the copy and a premium visual composite of image frames plus waveform-driven video cues to signal both products without overwhelming the text.

Place trust immediately after the hero using 3-6 recognisable customer logos in a restrained horizontal grid. Because the supplied proof is weak and no verified logos are provided, this should visually reserve space for logos while staying clean and minimal. If logos cannot be sourced, replace with a subtle metric strip rather than a moving strip.

Introduce a 3-step process under 60 seconds: 1) enter prompt, image, or script, 2) refine with multimodal controls, 3) export professional visuals or video. Use three compact cards with alternating icon treatment and short copy. This should be fast to scan and more explanatory than promotional, reinforcing confidence before deeper product detail.

Keep proof prominent and industry-relevant. Use the logo row again only if a stronger verified logo set is available; otherwise convert this section into a compact credibility band with outcomes, adoption cues, or performance metrics. The visual treatment should be lighter than the hero and more grounded than the process section.

Use tabs-with-preview for the first product because it has 5+ features and needs an interactive spotlight rather than a static grid. Default tab should open Seedream 4.5, with a visual preview panel showing image generation, editing, and composition. Then switch to a second alternating panel for Seedance 1.5 Pro so the rhythm changes from image-led to motion-led. Avoid flat feature grids.

Show the two product options as a concise comparison with the Seedance plan visually highlighted if video production is the stronger commercial hook, or Seedream if image generation is the primary click driver. Keep pricing dense but readable, with a clear Get started button on each card and no secondary CTA language.

With 4+ testimonials available, use a 3-card grid or compact carousel-static pattern. Emphasize creative role labels like Creative Director, Video Producer, and Art Director to mirror the target audience. Keep the cards visually expressive but still enterprise-clean, with a stronger quote treatment than avatar treatment.

End with a decisive conversion block that repeats the value proposition and offers one final solid orange Get started button. Keep the section tighter and more urgent than the rest of the page, but avoid introducing new claims. The goal is to close the loop from hero continuity to action.

blueprint.designPersonality: Premium enterprise AI workspace with a dark dashboard aesthetic, strong orange brand energy, logo-first credibility, and motion-focused storytelling for image plus video generation.
blueprint.imageryDirection: Use a dramatic product-led hero composite: abstract AI visual generation frames, waveform overlays for audio-video sync, and a video gallery rail with 3-4 cinematic preview tiles. Support the rest of the page with CSS-built dashboard panels, metric cards, and floating chips where actual media is unavailable.

referenceMap.heroPattern: Split hero with brand/logo lockup, large headline, concise value proposition, and short bullet proof points. Primary visual emphasis stays on the text block rather than a large media asset. The hero is compact and designed for immediate conversion.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Top hero band followed by a form/card capture section, with additional content organized as stacked product sections. Rhythm is linear and sales-oriented, using clear vertical separation rather than complex storytelling.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Simple elevated white form card with bordered or lightly shadowed container styling. Product content is presented in restrained content blocks rather than highly decorative cards. Overall card treatment is functional, dense, and lead-gen focused.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: One primary conversion CTA in the hero and section-level action CTA in product blocks. CTA hierarchy is clear and sparse, with limited secondary action presence. Buttons are used to drive lead capture or demo requests.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No pricing pattern is shown in the reference structure.
referenceMap.footerMode: Footer is not visible in the provided reference markup, so no reusable footer pattern can be inferred.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Minimal media usage in the hero; emphasis is on text and brand. If media appears, it is expected to be small supporting imagery rather than full-width visual storytelling. No obvious media panel or gallery pattern is present in the provided markup.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Stacked feature sections with a headline, supporting paragraph, and a list of benefit bullets. Section content is modular and can be repeated for multiple products or models. The pattern supports progressive disclosure by presenting a summary first and detailed capability points below.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead form block immediately after the hero, styled as a prominent conversion module. Likely includes hidden tracking fields, compact visible inputs, and validation support. Form is treated as a primary conversion surface, separate from informational content.
referenceMap.animationStyle: No explicit animation system is evident in the markup. The layout appears static and utility-driven, with emphasis on structure over motion.

Prefer straightforward stacked layouts over complex interactive navigation for professional audiences.
If adapting this pattern, maintain sparse CTA distribution and clear information hierarchy.

designStrategy.reasoning: This page is best positioned as a high-intent lead-generation experience for buyers already aware of AI content tools and evaluating ByteDance models. The audience is professional and results-focused, so the page should quickly establish premium capability, then move into product proof, use cases, and quote/demo conversion. Because the visitor trusts logos most, the trust system should lead with a visible logo band rather than testimonials or generic badges. A dark theme suits the advanced AI positioning and supports a premium, modern visual tone, while the requested video gallery should act as a proof-rich section for Seedance. The layout should stay clean and conversion-oriented: compact split hero, strong CTA, stacked product sections, pricing, testimonials, and footer.
